subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"notice."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Notice"** means to become aware of something or to pay attention to it. (किसी बात को देखना और सतर्क हो जाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I **noticed**__ a strange smell coming from the kitchen.*
 
 
 
• The sentence talks about being aware of something.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

In a busy bus station, there is a little girl sitting all __alone__ on a bench. She stares at the floor as all the busy travellers rush __around__ her. Some of the people are in such a big hurry that they do not __**notice**__ her. Other people look at her, but continue running to where they need to go. After some time, a man stops next to the girl. He is very tired after a long day of work, and he just wants to get to his home as quickly as ______ (4) ______ so that he can be with his family. But he cannot just leave this little girl alone. He cannot see her ______ (5) ______ anywhere. The little girl is no older than his own little daughter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Inflict"** means to cause harm or damage to someone or something. (किसी को अप्रिय या अनचाही बात मानने के लिए विवश करना, ज़बरदस्‍ती लादना)
 
• **"Detect"** means to discover or identify the presence of something. (ऐसी बात को देख लेना या खोज लेना जिसे सामान्‍यतः जानना कठिन हो)
 
• **"Neglect"** means to fail to take care of something or someone. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की उपेक्षा करना (बहुत कम ध्यान देना, बिलकुल ध्यान न देना या ख़याल न रखना))
